goal: Allow the bitcoin wrapper to find internal binaries on distributions with nonstandard directory layouts
Prevents execution failures on distributions like Arch Linux that install internal binaries to lib
reviewability: All reviewer concerns have been addressed and verified
agreement: Substantive support with all review concerns resolved
Verified by reproducing the failure scenario and testing custom prefixes (cyb3ralbert, hebasto)
Reported test and valgrind regressions were addressed and confirmed fixed (hebasto, cyb3ralbert)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it fixes installed wrapper execution on distributions that customize install directory paths
Without this fix users on distributions like Arch Linux cannot run the wrapper binary

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it enables the multiprocess wrapper to spawn internal executables like bitcoin-node
Prevents immediate launch failures when internal binaries reside in nonstandard locations

categories.name: tools
